Title: Manoj's Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 34 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Sonali - 60 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Anjali - 29 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vinod - 38 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Kavita - 26 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Manoj stands in the kitchen. Sonali and Vinod stand near him.]

Manoj: "What lovely weather!"

[Manoj cuts his finger while chopping onions and it starts to bleed.]

Manoj: "Yes, all right."

[The knife slips and Manoj's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Manoj: "Yes, of course."

[Manoj winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Manoj (laughing): "What next?"

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

[Manoj is asleep in bed in the ward. Sonali and Kavita stand near him.]

Manoj: "Kavita, look over here."

[Manoj opens his eyes and slowly sits up in bed.]

Manoj: "One more time!"

[Manoj groans in pain.]

Manoj: "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Manoj stands by the road. Sonali and Kavita stand near him.]

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[Manoj rides his motorbike to the market.]

Sonali: "How beautiful!"

[Manoj starts his scooter and rides off.]

Manoj: "Hey, look at that!"

[Manoj rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Sonali (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Manoj takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Sonali: "Exactly right."

[Manoj's nose is bleeding after the punch.]

Manoj: "Kavita, are you okay?"

[Manoj wades through the knee-deep water.]

Manoj: "I really enjoyed today."
